findings.text: blocking: the plan's write grant says to change only the key an assertion looks a row up by and to change no expected value, yet this line raises the representative-state byte bound from 1500 * 5 to 1600 * 5, weakening a guard outside the granted edit; the worker disclosed it in follow_ons, but the coordinator must decide whether the bound rises or the state is trimmed, since the two done-when clauses ("adds no failure against the base" and "change no expected value") conflict here.

item_verdicts.diff: read against base aac37e7d4, one commit 06eeb6623; it moves option_key into lane_context.py, imports it into prompts.py, rekeys the two tables, and migrates the granted tests' row lookups.
item_verdicts.done_when: the plan's done-when asks for pytest -rA over the new file and every granted test file adding no failure against the base, the representative_state_tokens figure at base and head within 2200, and ruff clean by delta; the gate the manifest records runs exactly that and its logs (head_gate.log 143 passed/3 failed, base_arm.log 139 passed/3 failed, same 3 ids) are on disk.
item_verdicts.goal: the node goal is to key the pick state's candidate and return-time tables by each option's lane, model and backend key; prompts.py:403 keys candidates by option_key(candidate) and lane_context.py:413 keys return_times the same way.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states the gate command and result, the base arm, two negative-control runs (logs/neg1.log, logs/neg2.log), the token figures (base 2082 / head 2167, ceiling 2200) and the byte-bound deviation under follow_ons.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's declared paths are the plan's twenty granted paths; every path in the diff is inside them, including docs/evidence/fragments/lane-and-model-routing/each-model-of-a-lane-has-its-own-row.html.

justifications.durability: tests/test_each_model_of_a_lane_has_its_own_row.py:150 asserts len(codex)==3 from the flight config, and negative-control logs/neg1.log shows that assertion reddens to 1 when build_state is keyed by candidate.backend again.
justifications.evidence: the gate at logs/head_gate.log runs the fifteen granted files plus tests/test_each_model_of_a_lane_has_its_own_row.py, the base arm at logs/base_arm.log runs the same fifteen, and both fail the same 3 ids so the node adds no failure.
justifications.fit: option_key keeps its existing shape and docstring at lane_context.py:334 and prompts.py:31 re-exports it, so reckon/crew/picker/__init__.py's existing prompts.option_key calls keep working.
justifications.goal_fidelity: prompts.py:403 and lane_context.py:413 key both tables by option_key(candidate), which is the lane:model:backend key build_questions already names at prompts.py:427.
justifications.reuse: option_key is now the single definition at lane_context.py:334 (prompts.py:31 imports it, no second copy), and a search of reckon/ for the f\"{lane}:{model}:{backend}\" composite found no other owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path is a declared write path, but tests/test_picker.py:265 was edited beyond a lookup-key migration into an expected value and weakened assertion the plan forbade.
